thread:
ops-bot: ALERT: log-rule 'store.write.failure' firing 420x/min in eu-west-1 on prod (pager: maya)

maya: saw the pager, jumping in. customer impact?

arjun: root cause looks like a burst of retries from a background batch job, lots of identical stack traces. customers seeing increased 500 rates for short windows, but not widespread.

leah: digging logs now — majority are `timeout while acquiring connection` from redis with identical message id. we should tune the log alert to avoid paging on the retry storms. current rule: `source:app AND message:/store.write.failure/` with threshold 50/min triggers.

maya: ok. action items: suppress noisy signature, add a refined signature for true store failures, update dashboard to show grouped counts. who can push a quick rule update?

arjun: I can do a minimal change: add an exclusion regex to the rule to ignore messages that contain `retrying in \d+ms` pattern. propose update: `message:/store.write.failure/ AND NOT message:/retrying in \d+ms/`

leah: that will cut noise but we still want to capture real errors. suggest also adding a grouping field `error_signature` derived from the stack trace hash. when group high-cardinality, we keep alerting.

maya: sounds good. dan can you canary the rule in eu-west-1 and leave global unchanged?

dan: yep. I'll open a quick infra PR and run the canary for 30m then roll global if green. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3245

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-15-5425 assigned to @maya (severity: P2)

leah: here's the exact Datadog/ES style query I tested locally: 
```
index=prod-logs AND service=store AND message:/store.write.failure/ AND NOT message:/retrying in \d+ms/
| stats count() by error_signature, env, region
```
this groups by a short hash of the stack to avoid flooding on identical retries.

arjun: for the regex we should be careful to anchor obvious patterns, use `retrying in \d{1,4}ms` to avoid accidental matches. also add `AND NOT message:/^DEBUG/` to keep debug noise out.

maya: after patch, we still want a fallback: if 5 distinct `error_signature` groups each hit >10/min then page. that will catch real multi-error incidents.

dan: updated PR includes both: exclusion, grouping, and a new alert condition `distinct_signatures >= 5 && per_signature_rate > 10`. canary started in eu-west-1 at 1965002800.

ops-bot: Canary metrics: alert count down 88% in canary window, p95 alert latency stable.

leah: pushed a short-lived dashboard tile: `store.write.failure — grouped` and a heatmap. link: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/boards/1369

arjun: once canary finishes, let's also add a regression test to alerting CI — feed in synthetic retry logs and assert no page. I'll add unit test in alerting repo.

maya: agree. plan: canary 30m, if green merge PR and roll to prod, then update runbook steps to include `if noise persists escalate to infra` and add the new signature list to runbook. I'll own runbook update.

dan: canary ended at 1965003440, looks clean. merging now and kicking global rollout.

ops-bot: Deploy check: infra PR merged by dan at 1965003498. Global rule rollout started.

leah: after rollout, we're seeing a 92% reduction in pages and AWS error rates returned to baseline. leaving the new dashboard pinned for 24h.

arjun: follow-up TODOs: 1) Move exclusion into parameterized rule so we can tune via console without PR, 2) Add alerting CI tests + synthetic workload, 3) Schedule 1h postmortem to capture detection gaps.

maya: thanks all — good quick mitigation. I'll handoff to oncall for monitoring during business hours.

ops-bot: Handoff: @arjun on-call for next 8 hours.

maya: runbook updated and linked: https://wiki.redwood/company/sre/runbooks/store-write-failures

leah: note for audit — logged the regex and signatures in alert-change-log ticket: https://tracker.redwood/ALERTS-5021

arjun: closing thread, will follow up in postmortem with graphs and the alert CI PR id. :white_check_mark:
